description: Drives every Stage 3 pipeline path deterministically (§4.1-§4.4): universe filtering, band escalation, in-band collapse, per-symbol cooldown, exact and near-duplicate news, a CRITICAL move, a CRITICAL halt, and a market-wide status. Timestamps are epoch millis at one-minute spacing from 1700000000000. The sector rate cap is exercised in unit tests instead, where a small N keeps the fixture readable.

events._note: 0% — below entry threshold; refreshes the snapshot only
+3.5% — crosses into band 1: MEDIUM, trigger cross_+3pct
+5.5% — band 2 beats the cooldown: HIGH, trigger cross_+5pct

events.title: Nvidia raises full year revenue guidance
events._note: MEDIUM — news is never CRITICAL in v0

events.title: Nvidia raises full-year revenue guidance.
events._note: re-issued under a new id — collapsed by SimHash near-dedup

events._note: same news_id again — collapsed by exact dedup

events.title: Unlisted biotech announces merger
events._note: outside the universe allowlist — dropped, not counted
-3.5% — band 1 in Energy: MEDIUM, trigger cross_-3pct
-0.5% — back below entry threshold; resets the current band
-3.6% five minutes later — suppressed by the 15-minute cooldown
halt on a universe symbol: CRITICAL
market-wide status: LOW, empty sector, bypasses sector filters
